title: Add VPC control-plane Terraform: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, SGs, peering & Route53
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Add Terraform module and wiring for multi-AZ VPC control plane provisioning: public/private subnets, interface endpoints, security group templates, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone automation. Includes Helm value additions and upgrade/rollback hooks for the private installer.
description: Context: customers running Redwood Private need a repeatable, cross-account Terraform module to provision control-plane networking across multiple AZs. This PR adds a reusable module and integrates it into the private-installer path so teams can bootstrap multi-AZ control planes with interface endpoints, curated security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone forwarding. Motivation: reduce manual post-install networking steps, support cross-account deployments for large enterprise customers, and provide predictable upgrade/rollback behavior. What this PR does: adds terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane with submodules for subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, peering, and route53; wires the module into installer/terraform/controls with sensible defaults and explicit variable maps; updates helm/redwood-private/values.yaml to expose endpoint and dns configuration; adds upgrade-hooks and an integration rollback test. Testing: terraform validate/plan output preserved, unit tests for SG templates, manual multi-account test in AWS sandbox, automated upgrade/rollback integration test added. Checklist: [x] Terraform module added; [x] Helm values updated; [x] Installer wiring and docs added; [x] Upgrade and rollback hooks + integration test; [x] Security review comments addressed. Related: ENG-1278, INF-542. Deployment notes: defaults provision private hosted zone in control account and creates Route53 forwarding records in customer VPCs when cross-account peering is enabled.
